not_found_body: This page or tank does not exist, or you don't have access to it.
err_network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
err_internal: The server had a problem. Please try again later.
err_unauthenticated: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
err_csrf_failed: The request was blocked for security reasons. Reload the page and try again.
err_email_not_verified: Verify your email address before doing this.
err_not_found: Not found, or you don't have access.
err_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
err_server_busy: The server is busy. Try again in a moment.
err_version_conflict: This was changed somewhere else. Reload and make your change again.
err_tank_archived: This tank is archived and can't be changed.
err_invalid_token: This link is invalid or has expired.
err_validation_failed: Some fields need attention. See the messages below.
f_invalid_characters: Contains characters that aren't allowed (control or hidden characters).
f_too_common: This password is too common. Choose another one.
f_matches_email: The password can't be your email address.
f_invalid_decimal: Enter a number, using a dot for decimals (for example 60.5).
f_out_of_range: This value is out of range.
f_out_of_range_decimal: At most {max_integer_digits} digits before and {max_decimals} after the decimal point.
f_cannot_share_with_self: You can't share a tank with yourself.
f_exactly_one_of: Enter an email address or a username.
f_dimensions_all_or_none: Enter all three dimensions, or leave all three empty.
password_hint: At least 10 characters. A memorable phrase works well.
register_sent_body: We sent a verification link to {email}. It expires in 24 hours.
verify_missing_token: The link is incomplete. Open the link from the email again.
forgot_intro: Enter your account's email and we'll send you a link to reset your password.
forgot_sent: If this email has an account, a reset link is on its way (it expires in 1 hour).
reset_success: Your password is set. Every session was signed out; please sign in again.
unverified_banner: Your email address is not verified yet.
system_volume_hint: All the water in the system. Used for dose and water-change calculations.
warn_system_below_display: The total system volume is smaller than the display volume. That can be right when rock displaces water, but please double-check.
archive_confirm_body: An archived tank stays readable but can no longer be edited or receive new data. This can't be undone.
archived_notice: This tank is archived and read-only.
viewer_notice: This tank is shared with you. You can view it but not change it.
leave_confirm_body: You won't see this tank any more unless the owner shares it again.
sharing_intro: People you share with can see this tank and its data but can't change anything.
shares_list: People who can view this tank
username_hint: 3–30 characters: lowercase letters, digits and underscores.
timezone_hint: Only changes how times are shown; stored data stays the same.
password_changed: Password changed. Your other devices were signed out.
logout_all_body: Sign out on every device, including this one.
delete_body: Your account is deactivated at once and every session is signed out. Personal data is erased or anonymized after 30 days. Tanks you shared will no longer be visible to others.
deleted_notice: Your account was deactivated. Personal data will be erased after {date}.
rec_monthday_capped: Not every month has a day {day}, so the schedule uses the 28th.
rec_preview_none: No dates in the coming year.
rec_preview_invalid: Check the schedule fields to see a preview.
rec_not_editable: This schedule uses a rule the form can’t edit yet ({rule}); you can still change the volume, notes or status.
wc_estimate_summary: About {percent} of the total system volume ({volume} L, estimated)
wc_assumption_total_system: Relative to the whole system volume, not just the display tank.
wc_assumption_complete_mixing: Assumes complete mixing; this is not a measured share of water replaced.
wc_assumption_volume_as_entered: Uses the system volume you entered for the tank.
wc_flag_exceeds_system: More than the whole system volume — check the volume or unit.
wc_flag_large_change: Large change (over 50 %): match the new water’s salinity, temperature and alkalinity closely.
wc_overdue_hint: Complete or skip when you can. Missed changes are never marked done automatically.
wc_completed_at_label: When did you change the water?
wc_end_confirm_body: Upcoming dates are removed; history and overdue changes are kept. An ended schedule can’t be restarted.
err_already_resolved: This water change was already resolved differently. Reload the page.
err_schedule_ended: This schedule has ended and can’t be changed.
f_invalid_rrule: The repeat rule is not valid.
f_before_start: Must not be before the start date.
dose_missed_note: Missed doses are not made up automatically. Many experienced keepers advise against doubling up: if unsure, skip this one and continue with the next scheduled dose. If you do dose now, leave a good gap before the next dose.
dose_unconfirmed_note: ReefCare does not know whether your pump delivered this dose. Record what happened if you know.
dose_outcome_failed: Tried, but it didn’t go in (e.g. pump or tubing problem)
dose_confirm_over: Yes, I gave more than planned
dose_when_scheduled: At the scheduled time, just not logged
dose_nearby_warning: Note: another dose of this product is at {when}. Make sure the two are not too close together.
dose_attention_hint: Missed or unconfirmed doses. Nothing is marked as given unless you confirm it.
dose_plan_complete_body: Upcoming doses are removed; history and missed doses are kept. An ended plan can’t be restarted.
dose_pump_hint: For records only: ReefCare never controls a pump. Pump doses are never confirmed automatically.
dose_drops_hint: Drop size varies with the dropper, its angle and the liquid. Use the same dropper the same way each time. Drops are never converted to ml.
dose_no_products: No products yet. Add the products you use under Manage products.
dose_check_over_plan: This is more than 3× the product’s current plan. Check the amount and unit before recording it.
dose_check_unusual_unit: This product’s plan uses a different unit. Check the unit before recording it.
dose_products_intro: The shared catalog and your own products. ReefCare records amounts only and never infers concentrations.
dose_product_no_concentration: No concentration needed: ReefCare never converts between units.
err_plan_completed: This plan has ended and can’t be changed.
err_idempotency_key_reused: This request clashed with an earlier one. Reload the page and try again.
f_incompatible_unit: This unit doesn’t suit the product’s form.
f_confirm_over_planned: More than 1.5× the planned amount ({planned}). Confirm if this is right.
f_use_partial: Less than planned ({planned}): choose “Less than planned”.
f_not_less_than_planned: Not less than the planned amount ({planned}).
f_required_for_late_dose: Say when this dose was given.
f_before_scheduled: Too early compared with the scheduled time.
dose_nearby_unconfirmed_warning: Note: another dose of this product at {when} may have been given by the pump. Make sure the two are not too close together.
dose_failed_amount_label: Amount that actually went in, if known ({unit})
dose_powder_solution_hint: ml of your own mixed solution. ReefCare doesn’t know its strength. Note your recipe (e.g. grams per litre) in Notes, and start a new plan if you change it.
dose_early_note: This dose is scheduled for {when}. Only record it as given if you really gave it early; its reminder will go away.
eq_installed_hint: In {tz}. It can’t be changed later because the timeline is placed against it.
eq_remove_body: The device stays in history; its maintenance plans stop being due. This can’t be undone.
eq_effective_hint: Not earlier than the current version; earlier versions are kept as they are.
eq_settings_hint: Free-form per device (e.g. light schedule, pump speed). ReefCare stores them and never interprets them.
mt_title_hint: E.g. clean the skimmer, replace carbon, calibrate a probe.
mt_device_empty: No maintenance plans or records for this device yet.
mt_due_hint: Do it when you can; the next due date counts from the latest time it was done.
f_equipment_not_found: This device isn’t on the tank.
f_before_purchase: Can’t be before the purchase date.
f_before_installed: Can’t be before the device was installed.
f_before_current: Can’t be earlier than the current configuration.
f_after_removed: Can’t be after the device was removed.
f_invalid_value: Invalid value (text up to 200 characters, a number or on/off).
